definitions.explanation: Describes something that happens without being anticipated. Can refer to both positive and negative surprises.

examples.japanese: {思|おも}いがけない⟦{出来事|できごと}→出来事：03446_dekigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
{思|おも}いがけない⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会|あ}った→会う：00482_au⟧。
examples.english: I ran into a friend in an unexpected place.

examples.japanese: {思|おも}いがけない⟦プレゼント→プレゼント：01791_purezento⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらって→もらう：00520_morau⟧、⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{嬉|うれ}しかった→嬉しい：00822_ureshii⟧。
examples.english: I received an unexpected present and was very happy.

notes:
Describes something that was not anticipated or imagined beforehand. It conveys genuine surprise at an outcome or encounter that lay outside one's expectations.

FORMS:
- {思|おも}いがけない (adjective) — unexpected
- {思|おも}いがけなく (adverb) — unexpectedly
- {思|おも}いがけず (adverb, slightly literary) — unexpectedly

USAGE:
Primarily used as a modifier before nouns. The adverbial form {思|おも}いがけず is common in written language and has a slightly formal tone.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{意外|いがい}→意外：12741_igai⟧ — unexpected; surprising (na-adjective, more neutral)
- ⟦{突然|とつぜん}→突然：00409_totsuzen⟧ — sudden (focuses on timing rather than expectation)
